rationale: The Court is most likely to frame this as a Walker/Hanna no-direct-collision case, reading the Federal Rules at a level of specificity that allows Delaware’s AOM to operate as a claim-linked condition in diversity. Separate writings are most likely to split between a Thomas/Barrett concurrence emphasizing the Rules Enabling Act and a Kagan/Gorsuch-led dissent arguing the Rules supply an exclusive pleading-and-screening regime.
